articles.title: Oljepriset rasar efter Vances utspel om Iran
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Oljepriset rasar efter Vances utspel om Iran
articles.body_text: Oljepriset rasar efter Vances utspel om Iran Priset på olja faller skarpt. Det sker sedan JD Vance skyllt Republikanernas valförlust på Irankriget. ”Anledningen till att vi förlorade är kriget. Det sade presidenten själv i går kväll”, skrev Vance i ett långt inlägg på X under eftermiddagen svensk tid. I samma veva störtdök terminspriserna på råolja. Priset på Nordsjöolja (Brent) har fallit nästan nio procent under onsdagen och handlas under 95 dollar per fat. Amerikansk WTI-olja har fallit med nästan 8 procent, till 88,6 dollar per fat. Enligt CNBC ser investerarna Vance uttalande som en indikation på att valresultatet kan få president Donald Trump att börja förhandla med Iran.

articles.title: Klassiska cykelmärket Bianchi i rekonstruktion
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Klassiska cykelmärket Bianchi i rekonstruktion
articles.body_text: Marco Pantani på en Bianchi-cykel när det begav sig. Arkivbild från 2000. Klassiska cykelmärket Bianchi i rekonstruktion Den klassiska, svenskägda italienska cykeltillverkaren Bianchi har försatts i rekonstruktion. Bianchi ägs av den svenska koncernen Grimaldi, som genom Cycleurope även äger Crescent och Monark. Bolaget fick i förra månaden tid på sig av en italiensk domstol att ta sig ur sina ekonomiska bekymmer, enligt Bloomberg. Bianchi grundades i Milano 1885 och räknas som ett av världens äldsta cykelmärken. De är speciellt kända för sina turkosa racercyklar.

articles.title: Wall Street stiger – Trumps bolag mot strömmen
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Wall Street stiger – Trumps bolag mot strömmen
articles.body_text: Wall Street stiger – Trumps bolag mot strömmen New York-börsen öppnar handeln klart positivt och utan tecken på att tisdagens mellanårsval fått några negativa följder. Sjukförsäkrings- och vårdföretagsaktier stiger. Efter ungefär fem minuters handel har Dow Jones industriindex stigit 2 procent medan både breda S&P 500-index och tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex är upp 1,2 procent. I valen till representanthuset och senaten hade Demokraterna stora framgångar på bekostnad av president Donald Trumps Republikanerna. Olika sjukförsäkrings- och vårdföretag har en bra dag, med tanke på att dessa kan gynnas av mer demokratisk politik. Även flera av de stora teknikbolagen – som Alphabet, Amazon och Microsoft – stiger på onsdagen, mellan 2,5 och 6,8 procent. Elbilstillverkaren Tesla och rymdbolaget Space X med Elon Musk – allierad till den republikanske presidenten Donald Trump – har det betydligt tyngre med fall på drygt 5 procent.

articles.title: Digitala prenumerationer lyfter NY Times
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Digitala prenumerationer lyfter NY Times
articles.body_text: The New York Times har släppt nya delårssiffror. Arkivbild. Digitala prenumerationer lyfter NY Times Tidningen The New York Times fortsätter att locka allt flera digitala prenumeranter. Under tredje kvartalet tillkom 420 000 digitala prenumeranter jämfört med 280 000 föregående kvartal. Det innebär att det börsnoterade medieföretaget gjorde en vinst på 68 cent per aktie, högre än marknadens förväntningar. The New York Times har de senaste åren lyckats attrahera läsare genom att utöver tidningens journalistik även erbjuda läsare till exempel matrecept och olika former av dagliga pusselspel.

articles.title: Musk raljant efter valet: Rymdlasrar funkade inte
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Musk raljant efter valet: Rymdlasrar funkade inte
articles.body_text: Musk raljant efter valet: Rymdlasrar funkade inte Elon Musk har donerat miljardsummor till Republikanerna i valrörelsen. När partiets stora bakslag står klart slår mångmiljardären an en skämtsam ton i sociala medier. ”Antar att mina valstörande rymdlasrar inte fungerade den här gången”, skriver Musk på X, med en emoji som rycker på axlarna. Han skrev dessförinnan ett inlägg om att han tyckte att det kändes alltmer lockande att öppna datacenter i rymden. Elon Musk har donerat stora summor till republikanska kampanjorganisationer, motsvarande minst 2,8 miljarder kronor bara det här kvartalet. En av organisationerna lade drygt 1,5 miljarder kronor av dessa pengar på republikanen Ken Paxtons kandidatur i senatsvalet i Texas. Paxton förlorade mot demokraten James Talarico, som utropade det som en seger mot världens rikaste man (Musk) och ”hela etablissemanget i Washington”.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Kulturnyheterna special: Avgörs valet på TikTok?
articles.summary: För första gången finns alla partiledare på Tiktok, samtidigt som nästan hälften av alla förstagångsväljare säger att de oftare tar del av politik på sociala medier än i tidningar, radio och tv. Vad gör det här med politiken, och är det på en kinesisk plattform som framställs som en säkerhetsrisk som det svenska valet kommer att avgöras? Medverkande: Emanuel Karlsten, journalist, Kajsa Falasca, forskare, och Oscar Samuelsson, kommunikationsrådgivare. Programledare: Cecilia Tiberg.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
articles.summary: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.
articles.body_text: It was the midterm result that many in Canada had hoped for - a Democratic sweep that was in part a repudiation by American voters of Donald Trump's tariff on close trade allies. "I was doing cartwheels down the street," said Ontario Premier Doug Ford on Wednesday morning, calling it "a victory for Canada". Tuesday night's result is unlikely to grant Canada relief from those tariffs any time soon, but there is anticipation that the political shifts could create a more favourable environment for Ottawa to get the best deal now that on-again-off-again trade talks are back on. US voters cited affordability as a main concern heading into the midterms and a survey by the Cato Institute in September suggested that about 75% believe the tariffs have raised prices. In states like Maine and Michigan, tariffs played a significant role in the hard-fought races. In Maine, incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins clashed with the White House over tariffs. She successfully lobbied to have some duties that directly affected the state removed, including on road salt, refrigeration equipment and seaweed, but in the end lost to Democrat Troy Jackson. A similar story played out in Michigan, where state's the automobile manufacturing industry is deeply intertwined with Canada's - and where Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers. Trump's 25% tariffs on non-US made cars and trucks have led to layoffs in the province of Ontario, and have contributed to thousands of dollars in additional household costs for Michiganders, according to an analysis by the US-based National Taxpayers Union Foundation . Like Collins, Rogers sought to distance himself from Trump's tariffs, declaring in a TV ad last month that "Canada is not our enemy". El-Sayed, meanwhile, bluntly assessed the tariffs as "dumb" and blamed them directly for driving up costs. In Ohio, Senator-elect Sherrod Brown, who defeated Republican Jon Husted, called the levies a "disaster" and vowed to slash costs for voters by getting rid of them .

articles.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
articles.summary: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.
articles.body_text: Israel's President Isaac Herzog has begun consultations with political parties on whom to task with forming a new coalition government, after he received the official results of a general election last week he said had no clear winner. Herzog told party leaders that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid a new election. Neither the bloc of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his rival Gadi Eisenkot secured a majority in parliament. Earlier, electoral officials said there was no evidence of irregularities and that unsubstantiated claims by Netanyahu's camp of Arab-led parties "stealing" the election did not justify delaying the results' certification. The Shin Bet security service is investigating allegations of foreign interference in the election, but the head of the Central Elections Committee stressed that they would not fundamentally change the outcome. In the election on 27 October, Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox Jewish allies won 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset. Eisenkot's centrist Yashar party and three other Jewish opposition parties in his bloc won 48. Two Arab-led alliances, the United Arab List and the Joint List, together won an unprecedented 19 seats following a surge in turnout among Arab voters. That makes them potential kingmakers. However, all but one of the Jewish parties pledged before the polls not to work with them to form a government. The role of Israel's president is largely ceremonial, but after an election they have the role of inviting a Knesset member to form a government. That person will be given 28 days to do so, with a potential 14-day extension. The president has wide discretion to pick someone they believe has the best chance of building a coalition. They do not have to choose the leader of the party with the most seats. On Wednesday morning, Herzog was presented with the official results by Central Elections Committee chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg at a ceremony in Jerusalem. "In recent days, we have heard voices trying to cast doubt on the election results and to undermine their legitimacy. This is a real danger," Sohlberg said.

articles.title: Hungary opens secret police files, 37 years after fall of communism
articles.summary: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.
articles.body_text: Hungary has opened communist-era secret police files to the public, in a controversial move the government says will help Hungarian society heal itself from the traumas of 45 years of communist rule. Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and that the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish to family members. The date of the opening is symbolic - on 4 November 1956 Soviet tanks rolled through Budapest and other cities, to crush Hungary's short-lived revolution. "I ask everyone to treat this long overdue publication of documents with dignity and humanity," Prime Minister Péter Magyar told reporters at the state archives in Budapest. "Many families will now face difficult information, often related to a deceased relative," he added. "It is impossible to process a trauma without discussion and asking questions." Magyar defended the move, which was a central promise of his election campaign ahead of his landslide victory in April elections, as the fulfilment of a promise made by those who toppled the Communist party in 1989 in Hungary. In the ensuing decades, conservative, Socialist-Liberal, and Fidesz-led governments have all contemplated, but ultimately refused to open the files. Since 1998, it has been possible to apply for your own file, and for historians to research those of others. But many names were blacked out, and many files withheld by the post-communist secret services for their own use. Over the past 36 years, there were frequent leaks of data from the files, as successive governments tried to damage their opponents. Many files were also shredded, as the Communist party lost its grip in 1988-89. From Wednesday, the names and personal data of around 60,000 people recruited by the communist-era secret services have become available on the nyitottaktak.hu website . A typical entry records the real name of the informer, their codename, date of birth, address and mother's name, their motive for recruitment - whether voluntary or because they were blackmailed or coerced - and the name of their handling officer. Another batch of files, known as the "B-dossiers" are currently being digitalised, and will be made available on 25 February.

articles.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
articles.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.
articles.body_text: French authorities say that fridges used in medical facilities to store blood for donations were impacted by recent cyber-attacks by unknown hackers. The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers, with temperatures set to rise - but staff intervened to protect blood supplies. "No health impact has been identified and no loss of blood products is to be reported," the EFS said. Up until now, only supermarkets were known to have been impacted by the hacks. Meanwhile rumours have been circulating online about Russian hacktivist groups claiming they worked together to hack one of the systems that was used in the attacks which have affected European supermarkets. Noname057(16) and Z-Pentest Alliance posted that they successfully hacked Danfoss which led to speculation that they were the culprits behind the freezer hacks. But analysts now question whether or not that meant they were behind the supermarket cyber-attacks. While Russian groups are not being ruled out, experts say Iranian hacktivists or nation state hackers - or even teenagers pulling pranks - could also be the culprits. Cyber-security researchers at multiple firms are poring over evidence gathered from so-called "honeypots" to provide clues as to who is behind the waves of freezer hacks. Three separate cyber-security firms have deployed fake freezer software traps to monitor how hackers attempt to use them for attacks. In cyber-security, a "honeypot" is a digital decoy - such as a fake computer network or file - deliberately set up to look like a vulnerable target to lure and trap hackers. By monitoring these traps, security experts can safely study an attacker's methods without putting real systems at risk.

articles.title: Zelensky gives Melania Trump Ukraine's highest award after Oleshky ceasefire
articles.summary: Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet the US first lady at the White House on Thursday.
articles.body_text: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has given the country's highest award for women to the US First Lady, Melania Trump. The Order of Princess Olha, 1st Class, was awarded to Melania Trump for her "significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine", according to the presidential decree. It comes after the end of ceasefire in Ukraine's southern region of Kherson, which allowed for the evacuation of several hundred people from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky . Russian and Ukrainian delegations - made up of ombudsmen who were involved in the evacuation mission as well as senior officials - are due to meet at the White House on Thursday on Melania Trump's invitation. The White House said that Melania Trump had "independently initiated engagement between the two warring nations and successfully secured a ceasefire". "This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady", it added. Both the Russian and Ukrainian sides repeatedly thanked Melania Trump for brokering the ceasefire, though neither elaborated on the nature or extent of her involvement. The delegations travelling to the White House on Thursday will include Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and his Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova, as well as Ukrainian MP Davyd Arakhamia and Russian senior official Kirill Dmitriev. Lubinets and Lantratova travelled together into Oleshky last week, in an unusual show of cooperation between Russian and Ukrainian officials. Arakhamia, a Ukrainian MP who heads Zelensky's party in parliament, has previously been part of the Ukrainian negotiating team during peace talks with Russia. He was responsible for informal contact between the White House and Moscow during the ceasefire, according to diplomatic sources quoted by Ukrainian media, and has confirmed he will take part in Thursday's talks. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the Russian delegation will be made up of Lantratova and Kirill Dmitriev, a Russian businessman close to the Kremlin who has frequently taken part in US-brokered ceasefire talks.

articles.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
articles.summary: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.
articles.body_text: Inside the Republican Party, initial shock at the stunning election results on Tuesday night quickly gave way to anger with US President Donald Trump. After Democrats won upset after upset in deep-red states like Texas, Kansas and South Carolina, some Republicans focused their ire on Trump, arguing that his focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost the party control of Congress. "It's on him. It's not on anybody else. It's a total, complete rejection of President Trump," Bill Miller, a top Republican lobbyist in Texas, told the BBC. "This is a disaster of the first magnitude. Nobody saw it coming like this." Most Republicans expected to lose control of the House and were clear-eyed about the challenge of holding onto the Senate in a tough election cycle that favoured the party out of power. But some said in interviews that Trump dragged them down with unpopular policies, a low job approval rating and obsession over construction projects in Washington. "It was just one mistake after another," said Gregg Peppin, a Republican strategist in Minnesota. "Clearly, in state after state, people did not like the president's policies." A White House ally said public disapproval with Trump over the Iran war, tariffs and the administration's immigration crackdown created a "perfect storm" in November. "There's palpable frustration [within] the party about how this has all played out," the person said, and much of it is directed at Trump. Anger with Trump "is extremely high". The BBC spoke to a dozen party operatives, campaign officials, White House allies and others, many of whom spoke on background to offer a candid assessment of Trump's approach to the midterms. Trump and Republicans had a lot riding on the outcome on Tuesday night. A stronger showing by the president's party - as happened in 2022, when Democrats under then-President Joe Biden lost just nine seats in the House, and gained one in the Senate - would have given Republicans some momentum heading into 2028. But Trump will instead face a motivated Democratic majority in Congress that is eager to investigate the administration, block his judicial nominees and stymie the rest of his agenda. The midterms have ushered in an uncertain new phase in Trump's second term and may force Republicans to start grappling with their post-Trump future.

articles.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
articles.summary: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.
articles.body_text: Iran's chief negotiator in talks with the US has said that Americans voted "NO TO WAR", after President Donald Trump's Republican Party suffered a stunning defeat in the midterm elections. "We endorse this message," parliament speaker Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf wrote on X. "If the US [government] betrays their public will to serve international paymasters and blackmailers, it will learn our NO comes with a Nightmare," he warned. Trump acknowledged on Tuesday that the poor results for Republican congressional candidates were partly due to the war and the related surge in petrol prices. But he insisted that he did not regret launching a joint attack with Israel on Iran in February. In an interview with Fox News, Trump said of the midterm results: "I think a part of it was Iran". He went on to say: "People agree with what I'm doing on Iran but they really probably weren't willing to do the short term consequences of paying more for gasoline - I understand that." Speaking separately to the BBC's US news partner, CBS News, Trump said the conflict would end "when I say it ends". In recent weeks, Trump has warned that the US and Israel could return to all-out war after the midterms if a deal to end the conflict cannot be reached with Iran. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei - who has not been seen in public since he was reportedly seriously wounded in the same Israeli air strike on the first day of the war that killed his father and predecessor, Ali - said he did not expect US policy to change. Khamenei released a statement saying anyone who thought there would be any change from American "hostility towards the Iranian nation" was "gravely mistaken". He also said the war would have "much wider dimensions" if it resumed. In a separate development on Wednesday, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said four oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Air pollution: Indian capital Delhi's air quality worsens ahead of Diwali festival
articles.summary: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.
articles.body_text: Delhi is once again battling worsening air pollution as the onset of winter brings a familiar deterioration in air quality to India's capital. The city's air quality index (AQI) - which measures PM2.5, fine particulate matter that can clog lungs - has crossed 300, entering the "very poor" category and raising health concerns for millions of residents. Breathing such polluted air over prolonged periods can cause respiratory problems and worsen existing illnesses, with children and older people particularly vulnerable. Authorities have responded by invoking Stage II of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP), introducing measures to curb dust, vehicle emissions and other sources of pollution. GRAP is a set of emergency measures that become progressively stricter as pollution levels rise. The latest restrictions include more intensive road cleaning, higher parking charges to discourage private vehicle use and increased public transport services. Delhi Metro has introduced 20 additional weekday train trips, while authorities have been directed to stagger government office timings to ease traffic congestion. Officials said the measures were introduced after forecasts suggested air quality would remain very poor over the coming days. Delhi and neighbouring parts of northern India grapple with hazardous air every winter, particularly around Diwali, one of India's biggest festivals, which is just days away. The festival is celebrated with lights, lamps and fireworks, which often worsen the city's already poor air quality by releasing fine particles and harmful gases into the atmosphere. The annual pollution crisis is driven by a combination of factors, including vehicle exhaust, industrial emissions, falling temperatures, low wind speeds and the burning of crop stubble in neighbouring states. The sharp rise in pollution follows an unusually clean October, when Delhi recorded its lowest average AQI for the month in eight years. Experts have attributed the sudden deterioration to falling temperatures, slow winds and an increase in crop-residue burning in the neighbouring states of Punjab and Haryana. A recent storm had brought rain and stronger winds, helping clear the air. But as the weather settled, northwesterly winds returned, carrying smoke from burning fields towards the capital.

articles.title: South Africa local elections: ANC under pressure to reverse decline
articles.summary: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.
articles.body_text: South Africans are voting in highly contested local elections likely to see a haemorrhaging of votes for the country's biggest party, the African National Congress (ANC). This year's voting season has been marked by intense campaigns that have included politicians spinning cars, watching grannies knit and even wading through giant-sized potholes. Election officials say voting is going smoothly, despite long queues at some polling stations. Leaders are campaigning to head South Africa's nearly 300 municipalities, responsible for basic service provision such as water, electricity and refuse collection. For the ANC, the elections are a chance to prove it still has what it takes to govern. The party had a disastrous showing in the last national election, when it lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994 when the racist apartheid system ended. Support for the party has been dropping significantly over the years because of anger over high levels of corruption, unemployment and crime. At its peak, in 2004, the ANC got 70% of the vote in the general election. Two decades later its share dropped to 40%. Polls and pundits have predicted a further loss in these elections but President Cyril Ramaphosa has denied that his party was in a downward spiral. "What I'm seeing here is that the ANC is going higher and higher and on the 4th [of November] we will show those naysayers," he told supporters at the party's final election rally on Sunday. In townships like Alexandra, north-east of Johannesburg, the ANC has traditionally had a strong supporter base but poor governance and voter apathy are unravelling this support. The BBC visited the sprawling township a week before the elections and spoke to residents to get their views. One of them was Sanele Ntombela, who is a first-time voter excited to make his voice heard. We found the 18-year-old hanging out with his friends on a street corner. Most of his friends said they had no intention of voting and had not registered to do so.

articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.body_text: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este miércoles en S/3,450 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por debajo de los S/3,462 del cierre anterior, con una caída aproximada de 0,3%. La moneda estadounidense perdió terreno tras la victoria del Partido Demócrata en ambas cámaras del Congreso de Estados Unidos, un resultado que genera incertidumbre sobre la continuidad de la agenda económica del presidente Donald Trump. “El Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) retrocedió 0,57%, hasta los 101.311 puntos, luego de conocerse los resultados electorales. La nueva composición del Congreso podría dificultar la aprobación de iniciativas fiscales y comerciales del Gobierno estadounidense, lo que mantiene la atención de los inversionistas sobre el comportamiento del dólar y las próximas decisiones económicas”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, la debilidad del dólar favoreció la recuperación de los metales preciosos. La plata avanzó 4,65% y el oro subió 2,91%, mientras el cobre retrocedió 0,61%. Por su parte, el petróleo WTI cayó 3,43%, hasta US$93,43 por barril, y el Brent perdió 3,61%, hasta US$104,38, en medio de una toma de ganancias y una menor percepción de riesgo geopolítico. Los inversionistas también esperan la publicación del índice de servicios ISM de Estados Unidos, para el cual se anticipa una lectura de 54.8 puntos. En el ámbito local, el Ministerio de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur) viene coordinando con empresas navieras el uso del transporte marítimo de cabotaje para reducir posibles interrupciones logísticas asociadas al Fenómeno El Niño. La medida busca contribuir al cumplimiento de la meta de exportaciones de US$107.000 millones para 2026, equivalente a un crecimiento interanual de 17%. Asimismo, el reporte destaca un acuerdo de cooperación energética entre Perú y Estados Unidos orientado a impulsar el uso de energía nuclear en sectores estratégicos, como la minería y la infraestructura portuaria. Para el desarrollo de la jornada, el análisis de Kambista señala que la evolución del dólar internacional, los precios de los metales y los indicadores económicos estadounidenses serán factores relevantes para el tipo de cambio. En el mercado local, se registran vencimientos de depósitos del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR) por S/707.3 millones y depósitos del Tesoro Público por S/400 millones, mientras los operadores permanecen atentos a los flujos de oferta y demanda de divisas.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. articles.body_text: El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi) emitió una nueva alerta roja por precipitaciones en la costa norte del país vigente desde hoy hasta el 6 viernes de noviembre. La medida se da en el marco de un reciente aviso sobre los riesgos que significan estas intensas lluvias para la infraestructura y los habitantes de las zonas afectadas. El organismo alertó sobre este fenómeno a través del aviso N° 451 emitido el 2 de noviembre y que tendrá nivel rojo del 4 al 5 del mes. Para la jornada del 6 de noviembre, la institución establece un cambio al nivel de peligro de “alerta naranja”. El informe del organismo contempla que Tumbes recibirá lluvias de “fuerte a extrema intensidad”. En la “costa interior” de Piura, las autoridades prevén precipitaciones de “moderada a fuerte intensidad”. Durante este 4 y el 5 de noviembre, los acumulados de agua oscilan entre 5 mm/día y 55 mm/día en la costa. En la sierra, los valores se ubican entre 8 mm/día y 29 mm/día en esos dos días. Para el 6 de noviembre, los niveles en la costa disminuyen a un rango de entre 4 mm/día y 40 mm/día. Las precipitaciones ocurren junto a “descargas eléctricas” y ráfagas de viento con velocidades de hasta 40 km/h. La institución prevé granizo en las localidades de la sierra por encima de los 2.800 m.s.n.m. El aviso abarca a los departamentos de Áncash, Apurímac, Arequipa, Ayacucho, Cajamarca, Cusco, Huancavelica, Ica, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Lima, Piura y Tumbes.

articles.title: Últimos feriados 2026 en el Perú: ¿Cuántos feriados hay en noviembre y diciembre?
articles.summary: Conoce el calendario oficial de feriados en Perú para 2026 y revisa qué días libres quedan en los últimos meses del año. Consulta las fechas de noviembre y diciembre para planificar tus viajes, actividades familiares o próximos descansos.
articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Sequoia is consolidating into a smaller, Bay Area–centered firm, shutting down the programs and offices it built during a 20-year expansion while announcing roughly $10 billion in new funds.
articles.body_text: Sequoia Capital posted a memo to X on Wednesday morning titled “The Sequoia of Tomorrow” that’s full of surprises. The firm has raised roughly $10 billion in new funds, it says. It is also closing its London office, shutting down its Arc accelerator and its Scouts program, merging its early-stage and growth teams into one, flattening its partnership, and killing the Monday partner meeting. The framing is forward-looking, but the messaging is very much about rewinding to an earlier time when the team was smaller and focused more narrowly on Silicon Valley. Sequoia says as much itself. The firm describes coming out of a roughly 20-year expansionary phase during which it built multiple businesses in multiple geographies and says an unintended side effect was hierarchy. Nearly everything being undone here was built during that stretch, under a succession of stewards running from Doug Leone through Jim Goetz to Roelof Botha. One of the most surprising developments here is that the firm is killing two programs that put Sequoia closest to young founders. Scouts , which Sequoia launched around 2009 and, anecdotally, half the industry has since copied in some form, gave small checks to founders and operators to invest on the firm’s behalf; it was a way to see deals through people closer to interesting new founders than any partner could be. Jason Calacanis famously pointed Sequoia to Uber through the program. Sam Altman brought Stripe to Sequoia as a scout, too. Other early scouts included Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky and Dropbox founders Arash Ferdowsi and Drew Houston. Arc , launched in March 2022, was Sequoia’s answer to Y Combinator: a batch accelerator for pre-seed and seed founders, running several cohorts a year for seven weeks, with admitted companies getting $500,000 to $1 million up front. Both were bets on being early and being everywhere. Now Sequoia says it wants to put more energy behind fewer people and things. Also gone is the firm’s London office, which Sequoia opened in 2020 Several people will leave the firm as result. “We simply don’t see the need for a local presence,” the memo says, adding that Europe will keep producing “outlier founders” and that Sequoia can support them from the Bay Area. (If founders didn’t already feel pressured to move to the Bay Area or open an office in the region, they will now.) Luciana Lixandru, hired from Accel in 2020 as Sequoia’s first partner in Europe, says she was offered a move to San Francisco and declined. (“Europe is where my family is, and where I want to build,” she wrote on X.) She says she remains a partner and will keep her board seats while investing personally in European founders. For European entrepreneurs, the message is going to be particularly difficult to digest, especially as it follows Andreessen Horowitz shuttering its London office last year and Coatue closing its own in 2024. Sequoia didn’t say it won’t fund Europeans, but it’s definitely reinforcing here that the center of gravity is once again in the Bay Area. The rewind extends to people, too. The memo notes that Carl Eschenbach, the former Workday CEO, is very much back in the fold (he returned as a full-time partner in March). It also says the team has “reinvigorated the GOAT,” Doug Leone. Though the nomenclature at venture firms is all over the place — including Sequoia — the memo makes clear there are now seven general partners who primarily own and operate Sequoia: Alfred Lin and Pat Grady — who are the firm’s co-stewards — along with Andrew Reed, Shaun Maguire, Konstantine Buhler, Sonya Huang, and David Cahn, who joined the firm in 2023. There are other changes as a result. Jess Lee, the firm’s first female partner and an early-stage investor who oversaw its Arc program, is no longer shown on Sequoia’s investor page but rather as an operator in the role of its chief product officer. Stephanie Zahn, an investor who had joined Sequoia in 2015, has meanwhile left the firm entirely, announcing last month that she is launching her own new firm.

articles.title: I tried Apple's Siri Recaps. They're surprisingly useful — and a little unsettling | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Apple's AI-powered Siri Recaps won me over in just one day, despite my privacy reservations. But there's still room for improvement.
articles.body_text: On Tuesday, Apple rolled out a potentially controversial set of Audio Intelligence features into testing with the first developer beta versions of iOS 27.3 and watchOS 27.3. The betas bring four new AI features that allow Apple Watch Series 12 wearers to detect important sounds, identify songs, catch up on conversations, and take notes. After just a day with Apple’s Siri Recaps feature on my Apple Watch, I can already see how its value may ultimately outweigh any creepiness factor that comes from the AI-powered audio recording and summarization it provides. However, I also see areas where AI-assisted note-taking can go too far, capturing things that aren’t worth remembering, and where there’s room for improvement. It’s the two other features, Live Rewind and Siri Recaps, that have raised concerns. The features record and then transcribe or summarize the conversations happening with and around the Apple Watch’s owner. Live Rewind lets you go back to see what was said in the past 15 seconds, while Siri Recaps summarize audio throughout your day, saving notes of the important things that were said. Still, some are put off by the idea that we’re now normalizing the idea that technology is always listening . I find myself sympathizing with both camps. I often lament that we’ve allowed technology to become so pervasive in our daily lives, but I still see the value in what Apple has built. I haven’t yet had an appropriate time to test Live Rewind, nor do I think this will be a feature I use as often. I’m more likely to say “sorry, what?” or “can you repeat that?” if I missed something that was said, before turning to my Apple Watch for help. But with Siri Recaps, I immediately saw how this could become a feature I rely on regularly to save important notes for later. I was able to test the feature in a real-world scenario yesterday, when we were dropping off my teen’s car for repairs and picking up a rental. At both places, employees shared a lot of information about time frames, prices, and policies that were delivered verbally. The information came too fast to stop and write anything down. Yet when I returned to Siri Recaps later in the day, it had captured key details that I may need to refer back to. For instance, it noted the deductible, the repair time frame, the amount of gas we had in the rental at the start, and other things I wanted to remember. One complaint is that Siri Recaps had mixed this information with other topics that were later discussed in the home, like an errand we needed to run and what time babysitting was this week, something we were discussing in order to create an appointment on the family calendar with an appropriate alert time frame. I think these items should have been saved in a separate note titled “family schedule and errands,” rather than in the same note with the car repairs, but under a separate heading. Because I configured Siri Recaps to run at all times, it also captured non-essential things, like our “plan” to watch the midterms coverage on TV, which is not the kind of thing you’d normally jot down a note about. It also was a stark reminder that the feature was listening in on our everyday conversations. That’s something that could feel invasive in different scenarios, if the subject being discussed was more personal in nature.

articles.title: Google faces backlash for plan that would turn off Search for schools that restrict AI | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Politicians on the left, like NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan, accused Google of acting as an unregulated monopoly.
articles.body_text: Google was met with swift backlash on Tuesday after it announced that schools using Google’s K-12 software will not be able to use Search unless they opt in to using AI tools. Chris Phillips, vice president for education at Google, told The New York Times that “Search and AI are deeply integrated,” so if a student’s school doesn’t opt in to using AI tools like Gemini, then students “will not have access to search, and they’ll see a message from their school that indicates it’s not available.” Even as Google made this announcement on a busy Election Day, several left-leaning politicians took time to speak up about their concerns. Senator Bernie Sanders (I-VT) accused Google in an X post of “extortion,” writing that “Google is threatening schools: if you stop your students from using AI, we will cut off your access to Google Search.” Senator Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) said on X that Google is “more concerned with forcing Gemini into schools than enabling students to succeed.” President Trump claimed that AI oligarchs could regulate themselves because they “love our country.” Now, Google is threatening schools: if you stop your students from using AI, we will cut off your access to Google Search. That’s not love. That’s extortion. PAUSE AI NOW. Lina Khan, the former Federal Trade Commission chair and staunch advocate against monopolies, also condemned Google’s decision as anticompetitive. “This highlights the danger of allowing an unregulated monopolist to control an essential service,” she wrote . “Multiple courts have found Google liable for violating antitrust laws, and this latest move shows it remains unchastened.” New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani accused Google of being a monopoly, commenting , “No corporation should have the power to dictate how we teach our children.” Google is using its search monopoly to coerce schools into adopting AI. This highlights the danger of allowing an unregulated monopolist to control an essential service. Multiple courts have found Google liable for violating antitrust laws, and this latest move shows it remains… https://t.co/eajJN9yfQF While Search is a necessary tool for information gathering, educators worry that its built-in AI overviews could dissuade students from finding answers themselves. For millions of students required to use Chromebooks and Google education tools, using a different search engine isn’t a simple fix. Google says that it’s working on a “Guided Learning” tool for student accounts in Search, which is supposed to walk students through the process of solving a problem or finding information, rather than just handing them the answer. If a student is struggling with a math problem, for example, the feature may prompt them to refresh their memory about the rules for dividing exponents, instead of spitting out a number. In response to the backlash, Google pointed out in a post on X that it had listened to educators by turning off access to AI products by default and noted that schools could turn on Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually.

articles.title: Titan OS raises $46 million to expand its smart TV OS internationally | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Titan OS has raised $110 million in funding to date.
articles.body_text: Barcelona-based smart TV operating system maker Titan OS has raised $46 million in new funding, consisting of both equity and debt, the company announced on Wednesday. The money comes from debt facilities provided by funds and accounts managed by BlackRock, along with existing investors like Highland Europe and Mangrove Capital Partners. The startup, which secured $58 million last year , has now raised $110 million in total. The company said that it could have chosen not to raise money and grow slowly, but it wants to be more ambitious to create more partnerships and expand into more geographies. Titan OS’s promise to TV makers is that it offers better value from their unit sales by loading an operating system where they can generate money through partnerships with FAST channels (free ad-supported television) and ads on different screens. The company now serves 30 million users, up from 18 million last year. This includes being a sales partner for TiVo in some regions, along with Tubi in the U.K. Compared with last year, the startup has also added Sharp, AOC, Vestel, and Skyworth as partners. Its partnership with Philips has been a success, as the Dutch electronics maker has switched to Titan OS and ditched Google TV for its 2026 models . The extended coverage means that it has a bigger advertiser footprint and better audience engagement metrics to offer to marketers. “Our bread and butter is the monetization of our inventory on our own network. But the point is that we’re going beyond that. That’s why our reach has increased significantly, which then triggers the flywheel effect by also attracting more sales partners and more agencies that want to spend on our platform, whether it’s owned and operated or via our extensions,” Hyoung-Ung Kim, the company’s newly appointed CFO, told TechCrunch over a call. In the last year, the company has increased its headcount to 250 people, and also opened an office in London to concentrate on advertising. It already has offices in Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Taipei. With the new money coming in, the company wants to focus on a few areas. First is content discovery. It still takes everyone a long time to find something to watch. For that, it is using interface tweaks and AI to boost discovery, alongside partnering with more content providers like FAST channels. “What differentiates us here from the walled gardens is that we do not have our own content offering. Like Google is trying to channel people to YouTube. We do not have that, and we are impartial in our role in content discovery. We are working and trying to reduce time spent searching,” Tobias Pfalzgraff, SVP of people and marketing at Titan OS, said. Pfalzgraff also emphasized that the company is using AI to improve its ad recommendation and segmentation. While the company is dominant in Europe, it thinks that there are only a few manufacturers creating their own operating systems; more set makers would like to adopt its operating system, just like Philips did. The company also said that with increasing costs of hardware due to AI, manufacturers are thinking about long-term revenue generation opportunities as gadget sales slow down. “The TV hardware industry is not a very profitable business. That’s why they are so reliant on partners like Titan OS that share revenue after the sale of the TV. But now, of course, the chip sets, the chip prices are increasing more and more. Right. With the AI boom, they have basically doubled down on our partnership,” Kim said.

articles.title: Revolut's valuation jumps 53% to $115B in new share sale as it prepares to launch US bank | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Glade Brook, Coatue, and T. Rowe Price were among the investors that led the share sale.
articles.body_text: Revolut’s investors have completed a secondary share sale that values the British fintech at $115 billion, 53% more than the price tag it had gained in another share sale a year ago, as the company prepares to launch a U.S. bank in 2027. Investors including Glade Brook Capital Partners, Coatue, Durable Capital Partners, T. Rowe Price Associates, and Baillie Gifford led the share sale, which brought no new money into Revolut. The company declined to say how much stock was sold. Founded in 2015 by Nik Storonsky and Vlad Yatsenko, Revolut has grown from a money-transfer app into a financial services platform with more than 80 million retail customers across over 40 countries. It has established banking operations across Europe, and launched banks in the U.K., Mexico, Australia, and New Zealand this year, as well as secured banking licenses in France, Colombia, and Argentina. The company also began rolling out financial services in India earlier this year, and has received conditional approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a national bank, which it plans to launch in the first half of 2027, subject to final regulatory approval. The London-based company has grown increasingly profitable, achieving profit margins of 38% on revenue of $6 billion in 2025. Even though Revolut has built much of its business around consumers, its business banking division, launched in 2017, has become an increasingly lucrative endeavor. The division accounts for about 20% of Revolut’s gross profit, James Gibson, head of Revolut Business and a partner at the company, told TechCrunch in a recent interview. Available across Europe, the U.K., Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, and the U.S., Revolut Business processes more than £36 billion (about $48.6 billion) in transactions each month, including over £1 billion (around $1.35 billion) in the U.S. alone. The division generates more than £950 million (about $1.28 billion) in annualized revenue and holds more than £18 billion (roughly $24.3 billion) in customer deposits, the company told TechCrunch. Nearly half of Revolut Business’ new customers in the U.S. are newly incorporated companies, the company said. Revolut is looking to bring its business banking services to more markets, including Mexico, Brazil, and India, Gibson said, though he did not specify when the company expects that to happen. The fintech also aims to grow its business customer base from over 800,000 businesses to a million by 2027, he said. The company’s rising valuation comes as it weighs a public listing. Storonsky has considered a dual listing in New York and London and indicated a preference for a primary listing in the U.S. However, an IPO, which could reportedly value Revolut at $200 billion , would come no earlier than 2028, depending on market conditions. articles.title: Canva lays off over 1,200 people amid slowing growth | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Canva is cutting 22% of its staff as it faces its 'hardest year' yet.
articles.body_text: Design software maker Canva is cutting 22% of its staff, amounting to 1,271 people, amid a growth slowdown. The company’s co-founder and CEO, Melanie Perkins, in a note to employees said while Canva has scaled so far, it needs to change to address slowing growth. “Over the past thirteen years, we’ve turned a dream in a pitch deck into a platform used by hundreds of millions of people. None of it would have been possible without the talent, imagination, and care of every single person who has been part of this journey. Yet success in our first chapter doesn’t guarantee success in the next. This has been our hardest year yet, and as we shared earlier this year, our growth has slowed for the first time in a decade,” Perkins wrote. Canva is reshuffling its organizational chart and merging its product, growth, and platform teams to reduce communication friction. The company is also reducing “subspecialisation,” which means its employees might be asked to take up more responsibilities. The company is also moving toward hybrid work and asking people to work from an office a few days a week. The company has been shipping its own AI models to reduce costs and reliance on third-party models, but it still had to cut its revenue growth forecast to 20% from 30% to address ballooning AI costs. This also resulted in Canva’s early investors cutting its valuation to about $35 billion earlier this year. Canva is also facing increasing competition from AI startups and general-purpose chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini, whose image generation capabilities allow people to easily put together posters and presentations. articles.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models' identity | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
articles.body_text: Anthropic is working on an open source system to verify which AI model produced a given output, according to a blog post published Tuesday. The system, called FlashProve , is built to provide what researchers call “provable inference” — a cryptographic proof, essentially a mathematical guarantee, that a given output came from a specific model. It’s meant to let users confirm that the answer they received really came from the model they think they’re using. Similar to cryptographic email signatures that let recipients confirm a message really came from its claimed sender, FlashProve would be robust against impostors attempting to disguise one model as another, even when the impostor is the lab that built and runs the model. In particular, the researchers note that the system could be used to prevent an AI company from secretly swapping in a cheaper model to cut costs, or a more expensive model to inflate its performance results. FlashProve could also be used to verify claims by third parties that a specific task was done by an advanced model. “A developer might claim that their software library was scanned for vulnerabilities by a frontier cybersecurity model, or a company might claim that its business plan was given the go-ahead by an appropriate model,” the researchers write. “How can a user verify these claims?” To work, the system requires AI labs to publish a “fingerprint” of each model they release that can later be matched to specific outputs and verified cryptographically. Crucially, the fingerprints don’t reveal a model’s weights, the internal numbers that define how it behaves and which closed-model makers like Anthropic and OpenAI keep private. That means labs could publish the fingerprints without giving up their most valuable asset, enabling the system to work with commercial models, too. The system is also designed to be lightweight, so verification could be performed on a local device. As part of the announcement, researchers released a detailed technical specification and working code for various elements of the system, which is publicly available under an open source license on GitHub . Research in the system is ongoing, and there are no plans to deploy it at Anthropic or any other lab. “This research post is meant to share intermediate progress, and not a completed research agenda,” researchers explain in the announcement post. “We are sharing this explicitly with the goal that others look at what we have done, take it, and improve it.” When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.
articles.body_text: Stuck in years-long lines for grid connections and new turbines, some AI data centers are making their own electricity with converted jet engines, the New York Times reported Tuesday. The engines, pulled from retired aircraft and rebuilt to burn natural gas, aren’t anyone’s idea of a permanent power plant. But they’re another sign of how far power supply has fallen behind the AI buildout. For companies stuck in those lines, the main draw of converted jet engines is how quickly the engines can be up and running. “It’s all about getting power as fast as possible,” Rystad Energy analyst Audun Martinsen told the Times. With jet-powered units, “they can have a data center running in 24 months,” he said. Hooking up 100 megawatts to the grid in Northern Virginia, by comparison, takes about seven years , according to the International Energy Agency. Most power capacity is expected to come on by 2031, an executive at Mitsubishi Power, one of the world’s top makers of power generation equipment, told Bloomberg last week . In some cases, these delays are already costing some data center operators business. Last month, Microsoft pulled out as the anchor customer for Nscale’s data center in Loughton, England, after the local utility said it couldn’t deliver enough power until the early to mid-2030s. Elon Musk’s xAI is among the companies already using the engines, having installed eight converted jet-engine turbines in Mississippi to help power its Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, the Times reported, citing state permits and satellite imagery. The units come from ProEnergy, which rebuilds a GE engine commonly found on Boeing jets. In 2025, OpenAI followed Musk’s lead with gas turbines at its first Stargate site in Abilene, Texas. Crusoe, a Denver-based startup that builds AI data centers, is constructing that Abilene campus and ordered 13 of ProEnergy’s converted units in April. In September, Crusoe walked away from a $1.25 billion deal to buy 29 natural gas turbines from Boom Supersonic, a startup developing a supersonic passenger jet that has also begun selling a version of that jet’s engine as a power plant for data centers. A Crusoe spokesperson told TechCrunch at the time that the company still plans to use turbines. Currently the Trump administration is adding to the pressure by encouraging data centers to generate their own electricity. Converted jet engines come with trade-offs, though: They’re less efficient and pollute more than turbines designed for conventional gas plants, and it takes more of them to make the same amount of power, according to the Times. That may ultimately make converted jet engines a short-term play with some experts saying that efficiency and environmental concerns may grow in importance in a year or two.
